about: The AI settings a site names itself, as both backends must read them: AI_FEATURES in .env (Node, loadAiSettings in server/config.ts) and 'features' in config.php's ai block (PHP, AiConfig). Replayed by tests/unit/ai-config.test.ts and php/tests/ConfigTest.php. `env` is the variable's value (null: not set), `php` the key's value; a row without one of them is the other backend's alone. A refusal names the setting and never repeats its value.

accepted.name: both, in the app's order whatever order they are named in
spaces and a stray comma, as typed in .env

refused.name: a good name beside a bad one
